# FEATURE-MATRIX — phantom-mesh (feature-axis ground truth)

Synthesized from 7 per-SPEC-group read-only scans (foundation 01–09, protocol-interop 10–17, system-life 20–25, system-work 26–29+81, platform-mac 40–41, platform-ios 30–32, platform-other-server-test 33/34/44/45/46/50/51/52/60/61/62/63). Status legend: **DONE+TESTED** = real code + a test that actually exercises behavior; **DONE-untested** = real code, no behavioral test (serde/round-trip only does NOT count); **PARTIAL** = real on one path / stubbed on another; **STUB** = body is `unimplemented!()`/`panic!`/pseudocode; **MISSING** = no code.

> Honesty note carried through every section: the `*_wire.rs` "contract" files and the `tests/wire_round_trip.rs` / `wire_schema_validation.rs` gates only serde round-trip structs — they are counted as DONE-untested or PARTIAL, never DONE+TESTED, even when a green badge exists.

---

## 1. Pillar rollup

Counts are of feature rows attributed to each pillar (cross-cut/meta features counted under their dominant pillar; infra-only rows excluded from pillar counts and rolled into the infra line).

| Pillar | DONE+TESTED | DONE-untested | PARTIAL | STUB | MISSING | Pillar verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **P1 mesh / cluster** | 6 | 2 | 14 | 4 | 17 | Core HMAC + dispatch brain is real & tested; everything user-facing (idempotency, surfaces, mDNS wiring, peer-join UI, push) is PARTIAL/MISSING |
| **P2 multimodal** | 3 | 0 | 8 | 3 | 9 | "Image in / audio in" is the weakest pillar: pixels-to-model only works via daemon CLI; audio capture entirely absent; all mobile capture UI MISSING |
| **P3 evolve / coach+hermes** | 7 | 1 | 9 | 4 | 6 | Strongest *functional* pillar: coach review + hermes judge/extract/store real & tested; but the "closed loop" is ~3.5 of 6 steps (measure/sync/embedding STUB/MISSING) |
| **P4 encryption** | 8 | 1 | 7 | 2 | 14 | Client-side crypto primitives are excellent & tested (age, ed25519, HKDF, broker seal); but at-rest keystore is 2-of-5 OSes, broker E2EE is dead code, error/telemetry redaction MISSING |

### Pillar-by-pillar honest read
- **P1 mesh — DONE+TESTED core, hollow edges.** `rpc_wire` HMAC sign/verify, `mesh.rs` dual-accept, Tailscale dispatch, and the entire SPEC-26 dispatch brain (decompose/score/plan/integrate/orchestrate) are genuinely tested. But: idempotency is a stub (`core/src/idempotency.rs` doesn't exist), mDNS discovery has zero production callers, dispatch has no user surface (no `dispatch_task` cmd, no CLI, no `EventKind::Dispatch` persistence), no cost field, and mesh-peer-add UI invite/QR are `setTimeout` placeholders.
- **P2 multimodal — the false-confidence pillar.** The shipping daemon path (`life_node/capture.rs` → `/api/events` → `gemini.rs`) does send image bytes and is tested. But the spec-cited `capture_food_wire.rs:gemini_multimodal_pseudo` is `unimplemented!` ("model sees a filename, not the pixels"). Audio (SPEC-21: recorder/chunk/ASR) is entirely MISSING; `analyze_focus_session` LLM leg is `unimplemented!`. All mobile camera/PTT/widget capture UI is MISSING.
- **P3 evolve — most complete behavior, overclaimed loop.** Real+tested: `daily_review.rs` (aggregate, coach review, fallback chain, stats-only degrade), shame-free/medical lint, cross-platform scheduler generation, hermes judge/extract/store + FTS5. STUB/MISSING: `skill_wire.rs:record_measure`, embedding-recall leg, `/rpc/skill/sync` P2P handler — so "judge→…→measure" + "cross-node skill sharing" are not fully backed.
- **P4 encryption — great crypto, broken at-rest story.** Real+tested: `life_node/crypto.rs` (age), `identity.rs` (ed25519), `identity_wire.rs` (HKDF subkeys), `key_derivation.rs` (EventKey), `broker_vault_wire.rs` (seal/unseal/wrap, ~28 tests). But the at-rest guarantee fails almost everywhere: macOS/iOS Keychain, Windows DPAPI, Android KeyStore all `unimplemented!()` (only Linux Secret Service + chmod-0600 real); `identity.key` is plaintext on disk on Mac/iOS/Linux; broker E2EE is "fully implemented but dead code — server decrypts at rest"; SPEC-04 error PII-redaction and SPEC-07 telemetry `redact.rs` are MISSING.

## 2. Track rollup

| Track | DONE+TESTED | DONE-untested | PARTIAL | STUB | MISSING |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Life Track** | 9 | 1 | 11 | 4 | 12 |
| **Work Track** | 6 | 1 | 8 | 3 | 7 |
| **shared-core / infra** | 13 | 3 | 18 | 9 | 28 |

- **Life Track:** the daemon/CLI core is real (capture, focus timer, daily review, coach lint, scheduler, hermes). The mobile half is uniformly MISSING (camera UI, widgets, PTT, lock-screen, deep-link screens), and the `*_wire.rs` contracts (habit `*_pseudo`, `analyze_focus_session`, `send_email`) are STUB.
- **Work Track:** SPEC-26 dispatch brain is the single best-tested subsystem in the repo (pure Rust, ~25 real tests). But it has no user surface, no cost tracking, no events persistence; SPEC-27 LLM decompose is decapitated at both ends (provider HTTP stubbed below, Hermes injection / chunked re-decompose missing above); SPEC-81 has zero Rust.
- **shared-core:** carries the real crypto, the wire schemas, and the platform adapters — but the largest MISSING bucket lives here too (SPEC-02/03/04/06/07 foundation source-of-truth files & codegen, observability/OTEL, ship-gate orchestrator, scenario catalog, feature flags, release signing).

| **iOS** | ~3 real (`swift_cluster_fetch`, React page catalog, OAuth CSRF binding) | 0 iOS-specific behavioral tests (broker_login CSRF + tauri_wire deep-link are core-level, not iOS-driven) | 6 of 7 Swift bridge cmds, Keychain, APNs, background modes, state survival, all `T-ios-*` IDs | **see below** |
| **shared-core** | majority of real code | ~13 | foundation schemas, observability, signing, ship-gate | n/a |

### iOS code's actual local presence — explicit statement
`/Users/marklight/Documents/GitHub/hailmary/phantom-mesh-ios` is **NOT a git repo and contains NO app source.** It holds only `app/.vite/deps/{_metadata.json, package.json}` (stale Vite cache), plus a top-level `.claude/` and `RELEASE_PLAN.md`. No Swift, no Xcode project, no TSX, no Rust. **Every group report independently confirmed this.** All real "iOS" implementation actually lives inside the main Mac repo's Tauri app: React frontend `app/src/`, Rust commands `app/src-tauri/src/commands/`, Xcode project `app/src-tauri/gen/apple/`, one Objective-C bridge `app/src-tauri/native/ios_fetch.m`. Any roadmap treating `phantom-mesh-ios` as the iOS codebase points at a dead path. The Android shell (Kotlin foreground service / tile / widget, ~822 lines) lives at `app/src-tauri/android/kotlin/`, not in any `-ios` sibling.

## 5. Critical gaps (ranked by pillar-importance × risk)

### Tier 1 — STUB/MISSING that directly falsifies a headline BIG-GOAL claim
1. **P4 "encrypted at rest, only you can read" is broken on 4 of 5 OSes.** macOS/iOS Keychain, Windows DPAPI, Android KeyStore are all `unimplemented!()`; `identity.key` is plaintext on Mac/iOS/Linux. On iOS, provider keys are written to `~/.phantom-mesh/env` plaintext — the *opposite* of the spec's fail-closed Keychain. (SPEC-12/30/33/40/44). **Highest risk: the project's #1 pillar is unmet on every platform except Linux Secret Service.**
2. **P4 broker E2EE is dead code; the shipped broker decrypts server-side.** SPEC-15's own §0 banner: client-sealed path "fully implemented but DEAD CODE — zero production callers"; live Cloudflare Worker is at-rest server-decrypt with no `/vault/*` routes wired to the sealed path. Any "zero-knowledge sync" claim is false today. The strong `broker_vault_wire.rs` tests pass against code nothing calls.
3. **P2 "image/audio in" is largely not real.** Image-to-model works only via the daemon CLI; the wire contract `gemini_multimodal_pseudo` sends a filename, not pixels. Audio capture (recorder/chunk/ASR, `analyze_focus_session`) is entirely STUB/MISSING. No mobile capture UI exists. (SPEC-20/21).
4. **P1 "one codebase → 5 signed platforms" is unbacked at the Rust layer.** SPEC-63 `verify_5os_signed`, `build_release_manifest`, all rollback step helpers, and every per-OS sign script are `unimplemented!("Stage 3")` / MISSING.
5. **P1 dispatch flagship has no user surface.** SPEC-26 brain is well-tested but no `dispatch_*` Tauri cmd, no `phantom dispatch` CLI, no cost field, no `EventKind::Dispatch` persistence — the "$0.0238 across 3 machines" pillar demo cannot be produced.

### Tier 2 — DONE-but-UNTESTED / WEAK (fake-green risk on real code)
- **SPEC-10 dual-accept auth** — real code, only indirect coverage; the migration path that protects mesh auth has no dedicated test.
- **SPEC-26 execute_plan / refresh_capabilities** — real reqwest/HMAC, only error-path tests; no live-peer success or reassign-on-fail e2e.
- **SPEC-24 notification dispatcher** — real send, only a thin escape test; the headline "coach review reaches the user" only truly holds for markdown-file + generic-notification (coach delivery router not subscribed; email STUB).
- **SPEC-14 5-D resolver** — `score()` real and tested in isolation, but agent.rs routes via the old priority list, so the tested code is not on the live path.

### Tier 3 — Falsely-green test citations (badges that verify nothing)
- `v7_a11y_axe_core.rs::v7_a11y_axe_scan_no_critical_violations` — **vacuous pass**: skips (harness never exists) and the assert is a commented TODO. SPEC-06 WCAG-AA compliance claim is currently false.
- `release_pipeline_wire::build_release_manifest_hits_stage3_glob` (SPEC-29 & 63) — `#[should_panic(expected="Stage 3")]`: a green test that *confirms the function is unimplemented*.
- **All `T-*` spec test IDs are aspirational, not real.** Verified non-existent across groups: every `T-ios-*` (16 IDs), `T-macos-foundation-*`/`T-macos-screens-*`, `T-android-*`, `T-linux-*`, `T-broker-server-*`, `T-deploy-*`, `T-demo-relay-*`, `T-testing-*`, `T-scenarios-*`, `T-channels-*`, `T-signing-*`, `T-dispatch-*`, `T-30s-hello-ttfr`, `T-release-*`, `T-orchestration-*`, plus cited files `macos_types_roundtrip.rs`, `macos_screen_spec_roundtrip.rs`, `android_platform_roundtrip.rs`, `android_screens_roundtrip.rs`, `tokens_roundtrip.rs`, `routes_roundtrip.rs`, `errors_roundtrip.rs`, `core/src/idempotency.rs`. None exist.
- `spec15_broker_vault_e2ee_regression.rs` — green but exercises **dead code**; does not prove the shipped broker is E2EE.
- `cuj04_*` coach tests are credited by SPEC-41 S3 but exercise a **different backend** (`coach_wire::run_daily_review`, the CLI path) than the app screen's `daily_review_wire::load_daily_review`.
- `cuj02_*_todo` (record_checkin / streak_tz / cross_device_sync) and `*_wire.rs` serde round-trips are citation-shaped no-ops; do not count toward SPEC-22/24 behavioral coverage.
- The whole `*_wire.rs` family passes `wire_round_trip.rs`/`wire_schema_validation.rs` while `send_email`, `analyze_focus_session`, `record_measure`, `recall_skills` (embedding), and all habit `*_pseudo` helpers `unimplemented!()` at runtime.

## 6. Cross-platform interop status (SPEC-10..17, the coordination substrate)

The interop *substrate* (shared-core Rust) is real and well-tested; the *Mac↔iOS bridging* of that substrate has essentially **zero device/bridge-level tests** because the iOS platform layer barely exists.

| SPEC | Mac↔iOS behavior | real test? | reality |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 mesh-rpc | HMAC sign/verify both ends agree | **YES** (shared-core, `rpc_wire` KATs + `mesh_tailscale_test`) | Both sides share the same Rust crate; the *protocol* is tested. Mac↔iOS *transport* (private-IP fetch from iOS) has only `swift_cluster_fetch` real, **untested**. |
| 10 idempotency | duplicate task dedup across devices | **NO** | Stub; `idempotency.rs` absent. |
| 11 mDNS discovery | Mac advertises ↔ iOS browses (NWBrowser) | **NO** | Mac-side typed pipeline has zero prod callers + live test `#[ignore]`; iOS NWBrowser MISSING. The exact Mac↔iOS LAN-discovery handshake has **no executed coverage**. |
| 12 identity/keypair | per-device key, cross-device verify | **YES (algo)** / **NO (iOS persist)** | ed25519 + HKDF sign/verify tested in core; iOS Keychain persistence MISSING, so an iOS device cannot durably hold its key per spec. |
| 13 encryption (age) | Mac-sealed event readable by iOS w/ shared EventKey | **YES (algo)** | age round-trip + e2e tested; but no cross-device handoff test, and iOS EventKey lands on disk not Keychain. |
| 14 providers | same provider routing both platforms | partial | Shared core; 3 providers real+tested. Not a Mac↔iOS-specific concern. |
| 15 broker vault | Mac seals → broker → iOS unseals (key handoff) | **NO (real path)** | Sealed-vault crypto tested but **dead code**; live broker server-decrypts; iOS `vault_seal_key` handoff (SPEC-32 F8) MISSING. The cross-device E2EE handoff — the core Mac↔iOS sync promise — is untested *and* unshipped. |
| 16 event storage | shared sqlite/FTS5 schema both ends | **YES** | `event_storage_wire` round-trips + consumer CUJs tested (shared-core). EventKind 4-vs-8 divergence untested. |
| 17 tauri-bridge | invoke envelope + deep-link allowlist both platforms | **YES (Rust)** / **WEAK (iOS)** | `dispatch_deep_link` + `transition_onboarding` tested in core; iOS dual-channel cold-launch pull (`deeplink_consume_pending`) MISSING, so the iOS cold-launch path the spec targets is uncovered. |

**Bottom line for interop:** the *wire/algorithm* layer (10/12/13/16/17) has genuine shared-core tests and is the project's most trustworthy area. The *Mac↔iOS device bridging* of every one of those (private-IP transport, mDNS handshake, iOS key persistence, broker key handoff, cold-launch deep-link pull) has **no executed test** and, for mDNS / broker-E2EE / vault-handoff, **no shipping code path at all**. The coordination substrate is real on paper and on Mac; the iOS half of "Mac↔iOS coordination" is unbuilt.

---

### One-paragraph ground-truth summary
phantom-mesh has a **genuinely strong, well-tested shared-core Rust spine** — HMAC mesh auth, ed25519/HKDF/age crypto, the SPEC-26 dispatch brain, daily-review coach + shame-free lint, hermes judge/extract/store, event storage — and these are not fake-green. Around that spine, three things are systematically overclaimed: (1) **encryption-at-rest (P4)** fails on 4/5 OSes and the broker is not actually E2EE; (2) **multimodal (P2)** image-as-pixels and all audio are stub/missing; (3) **everything user-facing and mobile** — dispatch surfaces, iOS app (which does not exist at `phantom-mesh-ios`), mobile capture UI, release signing, ship-gate — is PARTIAL/STUB/MISSING. Most spec-cited `T-*` test IDs do not exist as real tests; the trustworthy tests are the differently-named in-module and `core/tests/*` behavioral ones enumerated above.

# Appendix — per-SPEC-group raw scans

I now have a complete and verified picture. The 9 foundation SPECs are nearly all design-only documents; almost none of the schemas/codegen/lints they specify exist as code in `core/src/`. The few foundation features with actual code are i18n (a different, simpler `tr()` design than spec), the shame-free lint, diag/event-log (not OTEL), and the i18n parity/placeholder test gates running against fixtures (not the spec's production catalog). Here is the analysis.

## Notes for protocol-interop

**Biggest gaps**
- **iOS is vapor.** `phantom-mesh-ios` is NOT a git repo and contains zero app source — only a stale `app/.vite/deps/` cache (a `_metadata.json` + `package.json`). No Swift, Kotlin, TSX, or Rust. Every iOS-specific capability in this group (SPEC-11 NWBrowser/Local-Network-privacy, SPEC-12 iOS Keychain, SPEC-17 iOS Tauri commands) is **MISSING** on the iOS side. The shared-core Rust substrate exists, but the "Mac↔iOS coordination" half on iOS is unbuilt. iOS-relevant code only exists as iOS build artifacts under the Mac repo's `app/src-tauri/target/aarch64-apple-ios*/`.
- **mDNS discovery (SPEC-11) is effectively not wired.** `mdns_wire.rs` has the typed `mdns-sd` pipeline but `dispatch_browse_events` discards every `DiscoveryEvent` (no sink), and `mdns_wire` has **zero non-self production callers**. The only live LAN discovery is `mesh.rs::discover_local_peers`, which shells out to `dns-sd`/avahi and string-greps `url=` — a parallel, untyped path that bypasses the spec's TXT-record contract entirely.

**STUB/MISSING that block a BIG-GOAL claim**
- **P4 "data encrypted, only you can read" via broker (SPEC-15) is NOT shipped as E2EE.** The spec's own §0 banner is the honest record: the client-sealed `broker_vault_wire.rs` crypto is "fully implemented but dead code — zero production callers," the deployed Cloudflare Worker is at-rest-only and **decrypts server-side**, and there are **no `/vault/*` routes**. Any claim that broker sync is zero-knowledge E2EE is false today. (The crypto primitives and their regression test are real, but nothing calls them in production.)
- **SPEC-12 cross-OS keystore is 2-of-5 real.** macOS/iOS Keychain, Android EncryptedSharedPreferences, and Windows DPAPI arms are `unimplemented!("Stage 4: requires <crate>")`. Only Linux Secret Service + desktop chmod-0600 file fallback are live. The BIG-GOAL "per-device key in OS-native keystore on all 5 platforms" is not met — and the mobile-no-silent-file-fallback rule means mobile identity persistence is currently un-runnable.
- **SPEC-10 idempotency** (`/rpc/task/assign` 24h dedup, G3) is a stub — `mesh.rs:1732` says client-side stub, and the spec-cited `core/src/idempotency.rs` does not exist. No duplicate-task protection ships.
- **SPEC-14 5-D routing brain is parallel/unused.** The spec itself (§9.2 T-PROV-01, Q8) admits `agent.rs` routes via the old `crate::providers::` priority list, not `providers_wire::score()`. The 5-factor resolver, `LatencyClass::Reasoning`, and the MCP `into_mcp_toolcalls` adapter are not on the live path.

**Falsely-green test citations caught**
- I did not find a falsely-green badge where a cited fn name is outright nonexistent — the spec docs in this group mostly cite `T-*` testing-strategy IDs (e.g. `T-rpc-idempotency`, `T-age-no-tmp-leak-5os`, `T-identity-ios-keychain-write`, the 8 `T-mdns-*`) rather than concrete Rust fn names, and **many of those `T-*` IDs have no implementing test in `core/tests/`** (no idempotency test, no 5-OS /tmp-leak scan, no iOS keychain test, no mDNS discover-3s/5platform tests). Treat those as aspirational, not green.
- Two "green-looking but hollow" citations to flag: (1) SPEC-15's `T-broker-sealed-blackbox` / E2EE guarantee — the regression test `spec15_broker_vault_e2ee_regression.rs` passes but only exercises **dead code**, so a green test does not mean the shipped broker is E2EE. (2) SPEC-11's `mdns_wire.rs` register/browse "live" test is `#[ignore]` (`mdns_wire_live_register_and_browse_smoke`) and never runs in CI, so SPEC-11 discovery has no executed end-to-end coverage.

# Feature Coverage: SPEC group `system-life` (SPEC-20..25, Life Track)

Two parallel layers exist and must not be conflated:
- **Real shipping layer** = `core/src/life_node/*`, `core/src/hermes/*`, `core/src/notifications/*` (the SPECs' named implementation owners; real bodies + integration tests).

**Biggest gaps (block BIG-GOAL claims):**
- **P2 multimodal "image in" is filename-only, not pixels.** `capture_food_wire.rs:gemini_multimodal_pseudo` is `unimplemented!` and its own comment says "the model currently sees a filename, not the pixels." The real shipping path (`life_node/capture.rs` → `/api/events` → `gemini.rs`) does send bytes server-side, so the capability exists via the daemon, but the spec-cited wire contract does not deliver it.
- **P2 audio capture (SPEC-21) is essentially absent.** No `AudioRecorder`, `ChunkBuffer`, or `AsrProvider` anywhere; `analyze_focus_session` LLM call is `unimplemented!`. "focus-session audio … into the agent loop" (BIG-GOAL P2) is NOT backed by code. Only a disk-state focus timer (`focus_session.rs`) ships.
- **SPEC-24 delivery is half-wired.** Real generic Telegram/OS notification exists in `notifications/`, but the coach-review router (`coach_delivery_wire.rs:deliver`) is not subscribed by the dispatcher (the file's own Stage-2 TODO: "把 `deliver()` 接進 `NotificationDispatcher::subscribe_coach_reviews`"), and **email/SMTP is a full STUB** (`send_email`→`smtp_send_pseudo` `unimplemented!`, no `lettre`). "coach review reaches the user" only truly holds for the markdown-file + generic-notification path, not the 3-channel parallel fan-out the spec promises.
- **SPEC-25 measure + skill_sync + embedding-recall are STUB/MISSING.** `skill_wire.rs:record_measure` (`unimplemented!`), embedding leg of `recall_skills` (`unimplemented!`), and the P2P `/rpc/skill/sync` handler (only DTOs + read-only `/api/hermes/skills*` exist). BIG-GOAL line 73 "judge→…→measure" and line 75 "cross-node skill sharing" are not fully backed.

- The entire `*_wire.rs` family is cited by wire-shape tests (`tests/wire_round_trip.rs::v1_*_wire_round_trip`, `tests/wire_schema_validation.rs::v3_*_wire_schema_stable`) that **only serde round-trip the structs** — they pass even though `send_email`, `analyze_focus_session`, `record_measure`, `recall_skills` (embedding), and all habit `*_pseudo` helpers `unimplemented!()`/panic at runtime. ## Notes for platform-ios

**Platform reality.** The supplied `phantom-mesh-ios/` dir is essentially empty — only `app/.vite/deps/{_metadata,package}.json` (stale Vite cache), no source, not a git repo. All actual iOS implementation lives inside the main repo's Tauri app at `/Users/marklight/Documents/GitHub/hailmary/phantom-mesh/app/` (React frontend `app/src/`, Rust commands `app/src-tauri/src/commands/`, Xcode project `app/src-tauri/gen/apple/`). Any roadmap that treats `phantom-mesh-ios` as the iOS codebase is pointing at a dead path.

**Biggest gaps (block BIG-GOAL claims).**
- **P4 "encryption-first" is not honored on iOS.** SPEC-30's central deliverable — `swift_keychain_*` with `WhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly` + fail-closed — is entirely MISSING. There is no Swift Keychain code, the entitlements file is a literal empty `<dict/>`, and `Security.framework` is linked but unused for SecItem. Instead, `app/src-tauri/src/lib.rs` writes provider keys to `~/.phantom-mesh/env` (plaintext) and seeds a local EventKey on disk (`encryption_wire::ensure_local_event_key`, lib.rs:393) — the opposite of the specced behavior. The OAuth JWT (F6) and identity master also land in the file vault, not Keychain. So "secrets in iOS Keychain" cannot be claimed.
- **6 of 7 Swift bridge commands MISSING.** Only `swift_cluster_fetch` exists. No `native/ios_keychain.swift`, `ios_notification.swift`, `ios_bgtask.swift`, and **no `AppDelegate.swift`** — which means push cold-launch (SPEC-30 G4 / SPEC-32 F5) and background-audio focus survival (G5 / F3) are structurally impossible right now.
- **No Background Modes at all.** `project.yml` has zero `UIBackgroundModes`; deploymentTarget is still iOS 14.0 (spec demands 16). 25-min background focus and coach push are unsupported.
- **Cross-screen state survival (SPEC-32 G2) is unimplemented** — no `phantom-app-state.json`, no `app_state_load`, no foreground-rehydrate hook. The deep-link cold-launch dual-channel is half-built (`listen` side only; no `deeplink_consume_pending` pull), so the exact cold-launch race the spec sets out to fix is still open.
- **Schema layers MISSING:** neither `core/src/platform/ios.rs::IosCapability` nor `core/src/platform/ios_screens.rs::IosScreenSpec` exist; `core/src/platform/ios.rs` is a bare `PlatformAdapter` stub. `app/src/routes/sitemap.ts` (SPEC-31's named single source of truth) does not exist.

**STUB/placeholder evidence:** F2 camera is explicitly a stub (capture-food.tsx comment: "Camera/photo capture is a native bridge (SPEC-30 deferred)"); SPEC-32 F4 streak/sync tests are `_todo` no-ops (`cuj02_..._todo`); SPEC-32 F5 has no `coach_review_mark_done` command; onboarding wire uses a `run_or_unimplemented` guard.
